summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True when written and False when not a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title with the control's second item; CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. Black formatting was not verified by running it.
